column1: # "Oracle-run budget (corrected, F9)": 110 planned vendor runs = 104 row runs
# over the 13 evidence rows + 6 adjudication runs in P3.T04.
# Per-task allocation, verbatim from the blueprint:
# P3.T08 re-runs P3.T07's designs at --level E1 and adds NO new oracle runs
# (blueprint P3.T08 "Expected vendor runs": counted inside P3.T07's 12).
# One vendor gw_sh invocation = one run. The open-flow companion (yosys +
# nextpnr + gowin_pack) of a run is not an oracle run and is not counted.
# P3.T23/T24/T25 + IODELAY re-shape, caps declared BEFORE the batches (D109):
#   p3-tlvds 3 (the three TLVDS types; the pads carry no DRIVE, so type
#   identity is the whole axis -- the blueprint's 6 assumed a DRIVE sub-sweep
#   the vendor does not expose on a differential pad), p3-tlvds-iobuf 1,
#   p3-elvds 3 (three ELVDS types; the VCCIO axis is one level because every
#   ball outside banks 6/7 on this board is 3.3 V -- SA-P3-1), p3-iodelay-b 2.
#   Total 9, cumulative 98/140.  Orchestrator cap for this task: 14.
# P3.T39 ADC fuse sweep, cap declared BEFORE the batch (D111): 8 runs -- the
#   six remaining VSENCTL values and the two remaining DIV_CTL values, which
#   is what completes both axes against the four points already on disk.
# P3.F3 B-half IOLOGIC, cap declared BEFORE the batch (gestalt-p3 B6): 3 runs --
#   one ODDRC, one OSER4 and one IDES4, each on the B half of a pad pair, which
#   is what the retracted "A half only" conclusion owes.  Cumulative 123/160.
